column1: # What never reaches the chat translation's backend (docs/notes/chat-translation.md,
# "What never reaches the model"; read by servers/lobby-server/src/v026g/translate/swear.rs,
# built into srp). One row an entry: lang (en ru uk de pl, or * for any), kind, entry.
#   word   a whole word (after the normalizing: lowercase, ё as е, look-alikes, leetspeak,
#          separators inside the word dropped, a letter typed 3 times or more once)
#   stem   any word that begins with it
#   allow  a word that begins with it is never one (innocent clashes)
#   block  a word that begins with it, or with spaces a phrase anywhere in the line: the
#          line is not sent at all (slurs, threats, sexual violence)
# A swear word or stem is masked (__X1__) and put back after the translation; a line
# whose words are more than half swearing is not sent. Add rows from what
# `srp-chat-glossary slang` finds in the chat sample.
# ---- Hand-made, srp (2026-10-23): stems for the inflected mat and its transliteration.
# ---- Hand-made, srp: innocent words the stems above would take.
# ---- Hand-made, srp: never sent (slurs, threats, sexual violence).
# ---- LDNOOBW, "List of Dirty, Naughty, Obscene, and Otherwise Bad Words", CC-BY 4.0,
# (commit 5faf2ba4): its single words for en, de, pl and ru (it has no uk), less the
# ones a shooter's chat uses innocently (escort, domination, suck, ...) and the slurs
